name: How long does an earthquake retrofit project usually take?

mainEntity.name: How long does an earthquake retrofit project usually take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of an earthquake retrofit project depends on its complexity and the extent of work required. A typical foundation bolting or cripple wall bracing project for an average-sized home might take anywhere from a few days to a couple of weeks to complete. More extensive retrofits involving significant structural modifications or foundation work could extend to several weeks. Your contractor will provide a detailed timeline after assessing your property and outlining the specific retrofit plan.
acceptedAnswer.description: Project duration varies by complexity, from a few days for simple bolting to several weeks for extensive structural work. Your contractor will provide a specific timeline.
